mechanics.claim: Noxious Trap deals damage only when it detonates (enemy contact), not when planted; the trap's stored AP-scaling damage updates if Teemo's AP changes before it explodes.
mechanics.quote: Noxious Trap's damage is determined when it detonates and not when planted, meaning if Teemo's ability power changes, the scaling is also altered to affect the active damage of all Noxious Traps so long as they do not explode.

mechanics.claim: Multiple mushroom hits on the same target only refresh the poison/slow duration rather than stacking additional instances.
mechanics.quote: Enemies who step on multiple Noxious Traps will only refresh the duration of the damage over time and slow.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the poison damage over time and slow but does not prevent the mushroom's detonation itself.
mechanics.quote: Spell shield will prevent the damage over time and slow for all units but will not prevent the detonation itself.

mechanics.claim: Noxious Trap's damage is persistent area damage, tagged as indirect damage, and applies spell effects.
mechanics.quote: Noxious Trap deals persistent area damage, additionally tagged as indirect damage, and applies spell effects.
